decisions.decision: Use one identical versioned real-event manifest for Astro, SoT and Penpot.
Keep 720px listing-body breakpoint and 759px shell breakpoint distinct until product evidence proves unification.
Loading, empty and error are explicit semantic states; do not hide ready content on terminal instances.
Do not create generic patterns from a single consumer and do not merge by visual similarity.
Isolated noindex Astro lab routes may implement the candidate; production routes remain unchanged.
Weather unavailable fallback keeps date context and a neutral unavailable status; no fabricated weather data.

Astro keeps the variable-font display weight 920; Penpot display styles resolve it to the supported maximum 900 instead of silently failing or substituting Times New Roman. The resulting visual delta must remain visible to conformance review.

Penpot Text.lineHeight is materialized as a unitless ratio. Pixel line-height targets from Astro are divided by font size before assignment; otherwise Penpot multiplies twice and produces extreme text boxes.

Date/today/tomorrow/weekend/popular mobile rails are Astro build-time rendered static listing rows. Client code owns filtering, sticky state and gestures, not data loading. Favorites/personal surfaces may load data only under their separate explicit contracts.

Penpot nested component text overrides are not trusted from API read-back alone: if bounded export still paints generic source text, exact frozen title/place adapters own the default content while remaining native linked components.
ListingEventCard title and place copy span the full card root width, including beneath a side proof/identity rail; media width must not be reused as copy width.

For exact poster event.real.8156, Astro currently paints the 512w derivative while Penpot holds the immutable original bytes. Cover geometry and object-position 50% 40% are normative; compression/raster delta stays visible and does not authorize a framing override.
ExhibitionRow internal image slider remains Astro-authoritative for this wave; Penpot must preserve the registered boundary and may not simplify production behavior during reverse integration.

Legacy mobile rail T01–T16 composition proofs are historical evidence. Only exact native states with same-fixture conformance enter active consumers; unconverted states remain an explicit delta ledger, not silently promoted variants.

ListingEventCard width and content-driven height are resolved in the concrete parent layout context. A generic media width or a fixed standalone height may not override the exact desktop/mobile/grid parent contract.
Timed and untimed listing group headers are linked exact-data adapters because label, count and multiline height vary together. Detached labels and review-only text overlays are forbidden.

Medallion identity follows the exact fixture meaning and linked semantic master. event.real.7807 uses the free medallion; visual similarity does not authorize borrowing world-ocean-museum artwork. The correction is applied at the parent-context card master so all consumers inherit it.

When exact source cover/object-position is required but Penpot ImageData exposes no object-position transform, a fixture-bound derived crop from the immutable source bytes is permitted. Its source hash, crop rule and derived hash are recorded; screenshots and hand-adjusted crops remain forbidden.
The shared rail-arrow-right primitive owns Astro cue color #8a7f76. Fixing the icon master is required so every linked summary inherits the same functional affordance color.

A typical mobile review board may contain only linked shell/accessory/archetype instances. Exact title/place/date/time/count content is owned by linked summary/track masters; ordinary review-board overlays are debris and must be removed.

Candidate Astro and Penpot date accessories use the Golden Event Corpus reference clock 2026-08-21. Wall-clock drift is forbidden in same-fixture conformance; production callers keep the live-date default.
Each exact date-cell adapter wraps a linked semantic Date chip state component. Weekday/date/month are registered content overrides; redrawn state styling and detached date chips are forbidden.

The mobile Announcements trigger uses the exact native vector wordmark and leather asset. The solid terracotta fill is a fallback under the image; a text substitute or opaque fill over the leather is forbidden.
The 10px feed-to-first-row gap is owned by the Mobile rail viewport master so every linked consumer inherits the same Astro geometry; review-board offsets are forbidden.

The loading/empty/error 360x240 state geometry is owned by the three native state masters. Browser border-box padding is translated to Penpot inner-stroke content edges; title wrapping, description line height, skeleton radius/gradient and vertical rhythm may not be patched on review boards.

Empty and error CTAs are linked instances of one semantic State action component. The label and exact fixture-resolved width are registered instance overrides; detached or duplicated buttons are forbidden.

Media identity is consumer-specific and must be read from the actual Astro listing render, not inferred from the event primary asset. event.real.7906 date listing resolves asset 0496a6ed…; Penpot reuses the existing native ImageData proxy for those immutable bytes and all linked consumers inherit it.

The stress upper viewport is composed only from linked exact time-header and fixture-bound compact-card adapters. Generic card masters plus ordinary cover/text/media overlays are forbidden because generated descendants duplicate and drift from the exact fixture component graph.

The tomorrow date header owns semantic eyebrow/title/count layers and four distinct rendered nav labels. The date eyebrow uses uppercase transform and 1.44px letter spacing; proxy labels without matching generated markup are nonconformant.
